strain: PCC 7942 rel- relA+ (rel deletion complemented with relA)
licence: Article CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (read 2026-10-06 from the supplied PDF; ledger decision 2026-10-06: permitted with citation, the distribution rule being withdrawn); GEO/NCBI public repository terms over the deposit

citation.text: Puszynska AM, O'Shea EK. ppGpp controls global gene expression in light and in darkness in S. elongatus. Cell Rep 2017;21(11):3155-3165.

units: mean gene expression values normalised with external RNA standards and cell number, as deposited

replicates.text: two biological replicates per genotype and time point

lightIntensity.text: 40 μE m-2 s-1 (μmoles photons m-2 s-1), cool fluorescent light

lightRegime.text: 12 h light/12 h dark with cool fluorescent light during the light periods; entrained by two further light/dark cycles, then sampled at dusk and through the dark period

co2.text: not reported: the article and its supplement name medium, temperature, light and entrainment only, with no CO₂, aeration or bubbling statement
co2.where: Puszynska and O'Shea 2017, Experimental Procedures, Cell Culture (article and supplement read in full 2026-10-06; package B/C addendum)
co2.quote: Cell cultures of wild-type and mutant cells were grown in BG-11 medium at 30 C under illumination with cool fluorescent light at 40 mE m2 s1 (micromoles of photons per square meters per second) unless indicated otherwise in figure legends.

phase.text: not reported as an OD or a growth phase at harvest; Table S6 lists the number of cells harvested per sample
phase.where: Puszynska and O'Shea 2017, Table S6 workbook mmc7 (read 2026-10-06; package B/C addendum)
phase.quote: Strain | Conditions | Time point | Cell number || Wild type | Light | dawn, replicate 1 | 868335000 || Light | dawn, replicate 2 | 868335000

caveat: Measured in an engineered PCC 7942 strain (the rel deletion complemented with relA), not wild type and not UTEX 2973; the rel- relAE335Q arm, whose synthetase is inactive, is not shipped. The workbook names the rel deletion spoT-. The darkness layer averages eight time points. Values are the depositors' read counts normalised with external RNA standards and cell number.
